body:
## Summary

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#136.

Adds a numbered pipeline stage navigator beside the pipeline stages and before the right pipeline sidebar. Each entry shows the stage number, output title, action, and upload timing when the stage updates YouTube. The navigator highlights the active stage with IntersectionObserver and scrolls stages into view when clicked.

Follow-up from review: the navigator is now organized as a sticky content-sized widget in the pipeline workspace instead of a viewport-stretched fixed panel, so its height follows its list content and only scrolls internally when needed.

Also collected issue/PR data and implementation analysis under `docs/case-studies/issue-136`.

## Visual Verification

![Pipeline stage navigator](https://github.com/konard/Jhon-Crow-audio-recorder-with-visualization/blob/issue-136-53e7af15b8b6/docs/case-studies/issue-136/screenshots/pipeline-stage-nav.png?raw=true)

## Tests

- `npm test -- --runInBand`
- `npm run typecheck`
- `npm run build`
- `CYPRESS_BASE_URL=http://localhost:8091 npm run test:e2e -- --spec cypress/e2e/pipeline-mode.cy.js`

Fixes Jhon-Crow/audio-recorder-with-visualization#136
